title: Miniature Sneaker Customizer Diorama
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a miniature sneaker customizer diorama using Three.js. Load the 3D model 'ABeautifulGame.glb' using GLTFLoader as a decorative diorama base/display piece.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 6) looking at the origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 8, 5) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- Set the renderer background to color #1a1a2e (dark navy).
- Load 'ABeautifulGame.glb' and place it at position (0, -0.5, 0), scaled to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5). This serves as the diorama display base.
- Create a simple sneaker model using Three.js primitives: a sole (BoxGeometry 1.2x0.15x0.5, positioned at (0, 1.0, 0)), a body/upper (BoxGeometry 1.0x0.4x0.45, positioned at (0, 1.3, 0)), and a toe cap (SphereGeometry radius 0.25, scaled (1, 0.6, 1), positioned at (-0.5, 1.15, 0)). Group these into a single group called 'sneaker' at position (0, 0, 0).
- Add a ground plane (PlaneGeometry 20x20, MeshStandardMaterial dark gray) at y=−0.5 with receiveShadow.
- Enable OrbitControls for camera rotation.

SNEAKER CUSTOMIZATION:
- The sneaker has 3 customizable parts: 'sole', 'body', 'toecap'.
- Each part can be colored independently.
- Available colors: 'red' (#ff3333), 'blue' (#3366ff), 'green' (#33cc33), 'white' (#ffffff), 'black' (#222222), 'yellow' (#ffcc00).
- Default colors: sole='white', body='white', toecap='white'.

UI ELEMENTS:
- Create a DOM panel (id='customizer-panel') positioned at top-right with a dark semi-transparent background.
- Add a part selector with 3 buttons (ids: 'btn-sole', 'btn-body', 'btn-toecap') that highlight the currently selected part. The active button should have a bright border (2px solid #00ffcc).
- Add 6 color swatch buttons (ids: 'swatch-red', 'swatch-blue', 'swatch-green', 'swatch-white', 'swatch-black', 'swatch-yellow') each styled as 30x30px circles with the respective background color.
- Add a 'Reset' button (id='btn-reset') that resets all parts to white.
- Add a 'Spin' toggle button (id='btn-spin') that toggles auto-rotation of the sneaker around the Y axis at 1 radian/sec.
- Add a 'Size' label and a range slider (id='slider-size', min=0.5, max=2.0, step=0.1, default=1.0) that scales the entire sneaker group uniformly.
- Display current configuration text (id='config-display') showing selected part and its current color name.

INTERACTION:
- Clicking a part button selects that part (highlighted with emissive glow on the 3D mesh, emissive color #00ffcc, emissive intensity 0.3).
- Clicking a color swatch applies that color to the currently selected part.
- The sneaker should gently bob up and down (sine wave, amplitude 0.1, period 2 seconds) always.
- When 'Spin' is active, the sneaker rotates on Y axis.
- The size slider scales the sneaker group in real-time.
- Pressing keyboard 'R' triggers reset (same as reset button).
- Pressing keyboard 'S' toggles spin (same as spin button).

STATE MANAGEMENT:
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
  - modelLoaded: boolean (true when GLB is loaded)
  - selectedPart: string ('sole'|'body'|'toecap')
  - colors: { sole: string, body: string, toecap: string } (color names like 'white', 'red', etc.)
  - spinning: boolean
  - sneakerScale: number (current scale factor)
  - sneakerRotationY: number (current Y rotation in radians)
  - sneakerPositionY: number (current Y position of sneaker group)
  - partsCustomized: number (count of parts that are NOT white, 0-3)
  - dioramaVisible: boolean (true if GLB model is in scene)

Make sure all state values update every animation frame.
physics_constraints: Sneaker bobbing follows sine wave: baseY + 0.1 * sin(time * PI). Sneaker scale must stay within [0.5, 2.0]. Rotation should accumulate smoothly when spinning. All position values must be finite (no NaN/Infinity).
